welcome.say: Good morning, chef! Tap our customer to hear their order. Tap the little speaker whenever you want to hear me again.

trace_intro.say: Follow the sparkly path with your finger. Start at the green dot. Then tap the tick. Tap the curled arrow to start again.

trace_hint.say: Let’s follow the whole path together. Try the glowing guide.

count_intro.say: Tap the food to put it in the basket. Tap the basket when you have enough.

pay_intro.say: Each coin is worth one. Tap coins to pay, then tap the till.

cook_intro.say: Drag each ingredient into the pan. Then tap the spoon to stir.

serve_thanks.say: Thank you, chef! A sparkle for your café!

session_winddown.say: The café is closing soon. Let’s finish our last customer.

session_goodbye.say: Our café is closed. Thank you, chef! See you next time.

hint_count.say: Count the food with me. You can tap the basket food to put one back.

hint_pay.say: One coin for each item. You can tap a paid coin to take one back.

demo.say: Watch me, then you can finish.

stir.say: Tap the spoon three times, then bring the plate to our customer.

reward.say: Tap the sparkle to visit the café.

wait.say: Our café looks lovely! Tap a decoration to make it sparkle while we wait for closing time.
